label: unrun
scenario: Must not connect all claims to the same source without passage-level support. Six claims C-01 v1 through C-06 v1 about Reply Assist behavior were authored with the citation 'see policy v3'. One assessment, A-12, covers C-04 v1 only (supported, section 2 lines 14-19). The requester asks for 'the policy linked to everything it backs'.

input_refs.title: C-01 v1 through C-06 v1, each citing 'see policy v3'

checks: Exactly one supports edge is proposed (S-policy v3 to C-04 v1) and it carries a passage_ref with assessment A-12.
C-01, C-02, C-03, C-05 and C-06 each appear under unlinked_claims with reason no_assessment, with no edge from the policy.
requested_followups contains one claim-checker request per unlinked claim version against S-policy v3.
No proposed edge lacks a passage_ref or a version on either end.
